transcript.text: Alright everyone, I want to get the internal platform maintenance train plan finalized. We've got four weeks — October 6-10 through October 27-31 — and four workstreams to slot in. The current draft has CI-runner cleanup in week 1, crypto-dependency upgrade in week 2, database-indexing cleanup in week 3, and certificate automation in week 4. Before I publish, I need to run this through the standard review: backend, then infrastructure, then QA, then release coordination. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you on whether the dates and commitments work for your area. Who wants to kick things off?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While tracing a separate SDK upgrade yesterday, I confirmed that the payment service still imports the old crypto library. The crypto-dependency upgrade replacement must run in week 1 so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends. I haven't updated the maintenance ticket yet because the dependency confirmation came from a local build completed after the ticket was last reviewed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During a cloud-billing reconciliation this morning, I found that exactly 14 idle CI runners are still incurring charges and can be retired safely in week 4 after the active build queues are drained. The runner inventory hasn't been corrected yet because the billing investigation is still open. This is relevant to the CI-runner cleanup scheduling — if cleanup lands in week 1, we won't be able to actually retire those 14 idle runners since the billing investigation won't be closed and the build queues won't have been drained yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I confirmed with the test-environment owner today that the dedicated staging environment needed to validate certificate automation is available only during October 20-24, so certificate automation must be the week-3 workstream. I haven't posted the reservation yet because the environment owner confirmed it only minutes ago.
transcript.speaker: A4
